appDescription.message: It's a free browser extension that scores job offers on what matters to you, not just pay. It reads the postings you open and your job alert emails, then ranks and charts every job by your priorities.

common_preliminaryHelp.message: Scored from the alert email only. Open the posting for a full score.

command_score.message: Score the job on this page

setup_welcome_title.message: Compare jobs on what matters to you

setup_welcome_body.message: $APP$ scores every job on pay, enjoyment, impact, career growth, time for life, risk, and location. Then it ranks them by what you care about most.

setup_welcome_footer.message: Free and open source. Your jobs stay on this computer.

setup_key_body.message: $APP$ uses OpenAI to read and score jobs. You'll need your own OpenAI API key.

setup_key_whatIsBody.message: It's like a password that lets $APP$ use OpenAI on your account. OpenAI bills you directly for what you use. $APP$ never sees your payment details.

setup_key_howToSteps.message: 1. Go to platform.openai.com and sign in or create an account. 2. Add a payment method under Billing. A ChatGPT subscription doesn't include this. 3. Open API keys and select Create new secret key. 4. Copy the key and paste it below.

setup_key_bad.message: That key didn't work. Check that you copied all of it and try again.

setup_key_noCredit.message: That key works, but your OpenAI account has no credit. Add some under Billing, then test again.

setup_key_cost.message: Scoring costs about $$1.20 per 1,000 jobs. Most people spend under $$1 a month.

setup_key_limitTip.message: Tip: set a monthly spend limit in your OpenAI account so costs can never surprise you.

setup_key_privacy.message: Your key stays on this computer and is only sent to OpenAI. Job text you score is sent to OpenAI to be read.

setup_key_laterNote.message: Without a key, $APP$ saves jobs but can't score them yet.

setup_about_body.message: This helps $APP$ judge each job for you, not for an average person.

setup_about_target.message: What work are you aiming for?

setup_about_targetHint.message: Example: nursing, marketing, skilled trades, or teaching

setup_about_enjoysHint.message: Example: working with people, solving problems, being outdoors

setup_about_community.message: How important is staying near your community?

setup_about_window.message: How far ahead are you planning?

setup_about_goalHint.message: A job that reaches your goal gets a 10 for pay.

setup_priorities_body.message: Pick a starting point. You can fine-tune it anytime, and the rankings update as you go.

profile_money_desc.message: Pay first, the rest barely counts.

profile_future_desc.message: Jobs that move you toward the work you want.

profile_life_desc.message: Time, energy, and staying close to home.

setup_priorities_describe.message: Describe it in your own words (optional)

setup_priorities_describeHint.message: Example: Pay matters most, but I don't want a long commute or weekend shifts.

setup_deal_body.message: Jobs that fail these are set aside, not deleted. If $APP$ can't tell, the job is not counted as failing.

setup_deal_minPay.message: Minimum total pay over the time you're planning for

setup_deal_languageGap.message: Skip jobs that need a language I don't speak

setup_email_body.message: $APP$ can read new LinkedIn and Handshake job alerts from your inbox and score them for you.

setup_email_how.message: Once a day, $APP$ opens your inbox in a minimized window, reads new job alerts, and closes it. Your emails stay marked unread. Nothing else in your inbox is read.

setup_email_signedOut.message: You're not signed in to $PROVIDER$ in this browser. Sign in, then try again.

setup_email_chromeOpen.message: Chrome needs to be open for checks. A missed check runs the next time Chrome starts.

setup_done_pin.message: Pin $APP$ to your toolbar: select the puzzle piece icon, then the pin next to $APP$.

setup_done_how.message: Open any job posting, select the $APP$ icon, then Score this job.

setup_finishCard_body.message: A few answers make every score more accurate.

popup_noKey_title.message: Add your OpenAI key to start scoring

popup_noJobs.message: No jobs scored yet. Open a job posting to start.

popup_paste_label.message: Paste a link or job text

popup_paste_hint.message: Works for offers with no posting too, like a text from a friend.

ranked_bestFit_single.message: Best fit if $DIMENSION$ is your priority

ranked_bestFit_multi.message: Best fit if $DIMENSIONS$ are your priorities

ranked_bestFit_equal.message: Best fit with everything weighted the same

ranked_bestFit_many.message: Best fit for your current priorities

ranked_breakdown_label.message: Show what makes up each score

ranked_breakdown_on.message: Each colored piece is one thing you care about

ranked_empty_body.message: Add jobs any of these ways: open a job posting and select the $APP$ icon, turn on job alert emails in Settings, or paste a link or text in the popup.

weights_hint.message: Drag a slider and the list reorders.

weights_movement.message: Arrows show movement since you picked a starting profile.

radar_subtitle.message: The shape of each job across everything you care about

radar_pick_hint.message: Pick up to three. Lines differ by dash and marker, not just color.

radar_pick_full.message: Three picked. Uncheck one to swap in another.

radar_rings.message: Rings are every 2 points. The outer ring is 10, the best. Tap a name to read each job's reason.

radar_overallNote.message: Numbers on the right are overall scores with your current priorities, same as the ranked list.

radar_standout_differ.message: They differ most on $DIMENSION$, from $LOW$ to $HIGH$.

radar_standout_pickMore.message: Pick one more job to see where they differ.

radar_standout_pickAny.message: Pick up to three jobs to compare their shapes.

radar_standout_note.message: Worked out from the scores, with no extra AI cost.

detail_payUnit.message: Pay unit corrected from per $FROM$ to per $TO$. $REASON$

detail_source_email.message: Added from a job alert email

detail_deleteConfirm.message: Delete this job? This can't be undone.

learn_card.message: You keep rating $DIMENSION$ higher than $APP$ does. Want $APP$ to weigh $DIMENSION$ more?

learn_cardLower.message: You keep rating $DIMENSION$ lower than $APP$ does. Want $APP$ to weigh $DIMENSION$ less?

banner_rescoreSmall.message: Re-scoring $DIMENSION$ after you changed it: $DONE$ of $TOTAL$ done, under $COST$.

banner_rescoreNew.message: Scoring $DIMENSION$ for your saved jobs: $DONE$ of $TOTAL$ done.

banner_ask_body.message: This takes about $TIME$ and costs about $COST$.

banner_waiting.message: $COUNT$ jobs are waiting for your OpenAI key.

badge_attention.message: $APP$ needs your attention. Open $APP$ to see why.

err_keyMissing.message: Add your OpenAI key to score jobs.

err_keyInvalid.message: Your OpenAI key stopped working. It may have been deleted or changed. Add a new one to keep scoring.

err_noCredit.message: Your OpenAI account is out of credit. Add credit on OpenAI's site, then scoring picks up where it left off.

err_rateLimit.message: OpenAI is busy. $APP$ will try again in a moment.

err_offline.message: You're offline. $APP$ will score this when you're back online.

err_badJson.message: $APP$ couldn't read OpenAI's answer for this job.

err_pageUnsupported.message: $APP$ couldn't find a job on this page.

err_pageChanged.message: This site changed its layout, so $APP$ couldn't read it. Paste the job text instead, or update $APP$.

msg_jobClosed.message: This job is no longer accepting applications.

err_mailSignedOut.message: Couldn't check your job alerts because you're signed out of $PROVIDER$. Sign in and $APP$ will try again at the next check.

err_mailChanged.message: $PROVIDER$ changed its layout, so $APP$ couldn't read your job alerts. An update to $APP$ should fix this.

err_storageFull.message: Your computer is low on space for $APP$. Delete closed or old jobs to make room.

settings_key_removeConfirm.message: Remove your key? $APP$ will stop scoring until you add one.

settings_key_limit.message: Set a spend limit on OpenAI

settings_dims_removeNote.message: Scores are hidden, not deleted. Add it back to restore them.

settings_dims_max.message: You can score up to 12 things. Remove one to add another.

settings_dims_payNote.message: $APP$ works out pay itself from the numbers in the posting.

settings_email_sendersHint.message: $APP$ only reads emails from these addresses.

settings_scoring_auto.message: Score job pages automatically when I open them

settings_scoring_autoHint.message: Uses a little OpenAI credit for every job page you visit.

settings_scoring_upgrade.message: Update preliminary scores when I open the posting

settings_scoring_threshold.message: Strong match means a score of at least

settings_data_where.message: Everything is stored on this computer. Job text is sent to OpenAI only when it's scored.

settings_data_exportNote.message: A file with all your jobs and settings. Your OpenAI key is never included.

settings_data_deleteAllConfirm.message: Delete all jobs, settings, and your saved key from $APP$? This can't be undone.

settings_data_deleteAllDone.message: Everything is deleted. Your key still exists in your OpenAI account; you can delete it there.

settings_help_copied.message: Copied. Paste it into your problem report.

settings_dev_raw.message: Show raw model output on jobs

ranked_nonePass.message: No open jobs pass your dealbreakers yet.

setup_done_illustration.message: Chrome toolbar with the puzzle piece icon and $APP$ pinned beside it

radar_axisAria.message: $DIMENSION$, your weight $N$. Show each job's reason.

radar_chartAria.message: Radar chart of $JOBS$ across $COUNT$ things you care about.

radar_emptyAria.message: Empty radar chart. No jobs picked.

appShortDescription.message: It's a free browser extension that scores job offers on what matters to you, not just pay.

setup_email_busy.message: A check is already running. Try again in a minute.

setup_email_checkingProvider.message: Checking that you're signed in to $PROVIDER$. A minimized window may appear for a moment…

setup_email_accountHint.message: If you're signed in to more than one Google account, pick the one that gets your job alerts. Account 1 is the one Gmail opens first.

setup_email_frequencyHint.message: Each check reads alerts that arrived since the last one.

setup_email_noCounts.message: Estimates appear after $APP$ checks your inbox.

setup_email_noCountsOutlook.message: $APP$ can't count Outlook alerts ahead of time.

setup_email_importHintSetup.message: $APP$ reads these when you finish setup. Reading is free; you'll see the cost before anything is scored.

setup_email_importHint.message: Reading is free. You'll see the cost before anything is scored.

email_result_done.message: Checked $PROVIDER$: read $EMAILS$ alert emails and found $COUNT$ new jobs.

email_result_asked.message: Found $COUNT$ new jobs. Confirm the cost in the banner above to score them.

email_result_error.message: The check didn't finish. Try again, or copy diagnostics from Settings > Help and diagnostics.

settings_scoring_spreadHint.message: On each dimension, your best job shows 10 and your weakest shows 1, so small differences are easy to see. Turn off to see the AI's raw scores. Your own scores are never changed.

radar_missingNote.message: Red points have no information, such as a job that doesn't state its pay. They sit at the center, on their axis.

radar_pick_hintAny.message: Check as many as you like ($COUNT$ shown). Click a name to open the job.

setup_about_windowHint.message: $APP$ compares how much each job pays in total over this time. A job that ends sooner only counts the weeks it lasts.

setup_about_windowExample.message: For example, $$20 an hour at 40 hours a week adds up to $TOTAL$ over $SPAN$, before tax.

setup_about_goalOver.message: How much do you want to earn over $SPAN$? (optional)

setup_about_goalHourly.message: That's about $HOURLY$ an hour at 40 hours a week.

setup_about_goalHint2.message: A job that reaches it gets a 10 for pay. Leave it blank and your best-paying job gets the 10.

setup_done_lead.message: You can change any of this later in Settings.

setup_done_keyMissing.message: No OpenAI key yet. Jobs you add will wait until you add one.

setup_done_emailOn.message: Job alerts from $PROVIDER$. When you finish, $APP$ reads alerts from the $RANGE$.

setup_done_emailOff.message: Job alert emails are off. You can turn them on in Settings.

setup_done_step1.message: Pin $APP$ so its icon is always in reach. Select the puzzle piece in Chrome's toolbar (1), then the pin next to $APP$ (2).

setup_done_step2.message: On any job posting, select the $APP$ icon, then Score this job. Or press $SHORTCUT$.

setup_done_step3.message: Right-click any job link and choose Score this job with $APP$. Or paste a link, or the text of an offer, into the popup.

ranked_notJobsHint.message: These looked like newsletters, promotions, or other emails rather than job offers. Open one and select It's a job if one is wrong.

ranked_notJobsDeleteConfirm.message: Delete $COUNT$ items that aren't job listings? This can't be undone.

detail_notAJob.message: This doesn't look like a job listing, so it isn't ranked. If it is one, select It's a job below.

banner_ask_choice.message: Scoring now takes about $TIME$ and costs about $COST$. At half price ($HALF$), OpenAI finishes within 24 hours, usually much sooner.

banner_half_title.message: Scoring at half price: $DONE$ of $TOTAL$ done.

banner_half_body.message: OpenAI is working through them and usually finishes within an hour; it can take up to 24 hours. $APP$ checks every few minutes while Chrome is open.

banner_half_speedUp.message: Finish now at full price (about $COST$ more)

settings_appearance_hint.message: Applies to the popup and this page.

settings_scoring_rescoreAllHint.message: Scores every open job again with the latest scoring, and fills in details that were blank. You'll see the cost first, with a half-price option.

settings_scoring_rescoreAllAsked.message: Check the banner at the top to confirm the cost.

settings_scoring_rescoreAllNone.message: There are no open jobs to re-score.
